done_when: Reviews use the model and effort in forge.toml's [models.review] when set and the review tool's default when not, doctor stops calling the entry ignored, and tests cover a new repo and an adopted earlier-release repo

known.title: Gate: update obsolete expectations in existing review tests

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Functional. Forwarding these flags makes existing required tests fail: they configure review models but still assert that `--model` and `--thinking` are absent. The conflicting assertions remain in `tests/test_close.py:495`, `tests/test_models_per_family.py:110`, `tests/test_aha_review.py:53` (also :96), and `tests/test_live_stage.py:100`. These tests run under forge.toml's full test command, so updating only the selected proof tests leaves CI red. Update the obsolete expectations to verify the configured values while retaining their other behavior checks.
findings.title: Gate: update obsolete expectations in existing review tests

why: Forge accepts a review model in forge.toml but ignores it, so a repo cannot choose the model or effort its reviews use
